propositions: Jira-specific REST probe logic (URL construction, basic-auth GET, status classification) must be relocated from neutral core `inbound_probe.py` to vendor-specific `adapters/jira/probe.py` to eliminate `adapters.jira` imports from core

A new `SupportsAbsenceProbe` capability Protocol must be added to `_backend.py` to enable backend-agnostic probe dispatch, with vendors implementing `probe_remote(remote_id: str)` as a capability method
The probe call in `run_differs.py:369` must be routed through capability check (`isinstance(backend, SupportsAbsenceProbe)`), with backends lacking the capability yielding `UNREACHABLE` result
The neutral vocabulary layer (`ProbeBranch`, `ProbeResult`, `ProbeConfigError`) remains in core `inbound_probe.py` at package root per ADR 0035 location pinning and dynamic load by filename
Backend-neutrality gate in `test_backend_neutrality.py` must be extended to assert zero `adapters.jira` imports in `inbound_probe.py`
